## Question / Question

What do you want to understand or accomplish? / Que souhaites-tu comprendre ou réaliser ?

## Context / Contexte

If relevant, give the firmware, installed nanoDNS version, Payload Manager version, and the public documentation section involved.

## What you already checked / Vérifications

Which parts of the [installation guide](../../docs/INSTALL.md) or [guide français](../../docs/INSTALL.fr.md) did you try?

## Privacy / Confidentialité

Avoid posting unredacted DNS logs, IP addresses, console IDs, credentials, or personal details. For vulnerabilities, read [the security policy](../../SECURITY.md).
